message.content:
This editorial illustration shows a stylized scene of people queuing on wide, light-colored stairs that lead to a building with thick, fluted columns. At the top of the stairs, a figure sits behind a rectangular brown desk, while others stand nearby. One person leans over the desk as if signing something. The figures are depicted in a minimalist style without facial features, wearing colorful clothing like jackets and headscarves. The lighting casts long, blue shadows across the steps.

White text at the top reads "TEMPO" and "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU". Other headlines include "Jalan Memutar Pembelian Alat Sadap Israel H.68" and "Kuda-kuda Modal Bank Kecil H.82". A large headline on the right reads "BAGI-BAGI JATAH MENTERI" followed by a paragraph starting with "Prabowo Subianto berencana menambah kursi menteri hingga 40...". The bottom left corner contains a barcode, a QR code, and small text indicating "6-12 MEI 2024", "RP 50.000", and other publication details. The overall color palette uses warm yellows, oranges, and contrasting cool blues.
